start: ^Jesus sent us ahead. He told us exactly where to find the colt and what to say if anyone questioned us. We weren't stealing anything! The Lord had authorised this.
^What about the rope at the post?
cloaks: ^Those are mine and John's cloaks. We used them as a saddle for the colt because it had never been ridden — we didn't want it to bolt on the road.
rope: ^John untied the rope — he didn't cut it. I don't know how it ended up cut. We were in a hurry to get back to the main crowd.
closing: ^The King is coming, and He's coming in peace. That's all you need to know.
